text:
anna: FYI received weights + tokenizer from partner (s3://partner-bucket/models/amber-3b/). Can we do a quick provenance + ingest checklist before registry?
mohit: nice, can you drop the manifest and checksums here?
anna: manifest: s3://partner-bucket/models/amber-3b/manifest.json
anna: checksums: 
```
sha256(weights.pt)=e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924... (truncated)
sha256(tokenizer.json)=9f86d081884c7d659a2feaa0c55ad015... (truncated)
```
sarah: quick questions: license on tokenizer? vocab size?
anna: tokenizer license: Apache-2.0 (manifest includes SPDX). vocab_size=50288. tokenizer files: tokenizer.json, merges.txt, special_tokens_map.json
julien: put a note to validate merges+vocab ordering — whitespace tokenization differences have bitten us before.
mike: also confirm byte-level vs. BPE; the tokenization tests differ.
mohit: proposed minimal provenance checklist: 1) manifest + sha256s match 2) signature verification (if provided) 3) license check 4) decode/encode roundtrip on a random sample 5) store copies in registry with origin metadata.
anna: partner included a detached signature (amber-3b.sig) signed by key id: 0xA1B2C3D4. julien can verify?
julien: I can verify. running: 
```
gpg --verify amber-3b.sig manifest.json
```
julien: GPG verified, key UID=Amber Research CI <ci@amber.ai>. fingerprint matches partner key in vendor whitelist.
opsec: please rotate access key used to upload to partner-bucket and confirm no creds in manifests. We should also ensure objects are locked to customer account KMS.
mike: noted. For registry storage: propose path /registry/model-artifacts/amber-3b/2026-03-16/ with metadata: origin_s3, sha256s, signer_key, license, ingest_user.
sarah: add tokenizer metadata fields: tokenization_scheme=byte-bpe, vocab_size=50288, merges_checksum=sha256-of-merges. Also add tokenizer_version and training_sentencepiece_params if any.
mohit: plan for quality/bring-up tests before making model available to devs: - smoke generation (10 prompts) - embedding similarity vs baseline on eval set - perplexity on heldout - small quantization sweep (8-bit, 4-bit) to check regressions - deterministic sampling run to catch tokenization drift.
anna: can we run quantization sweep on dedicated test pool? I can book a 1h slot on Dedicated pool A.
mohit: schedule it but keep batch sizes small to isolate per-token perf. Also record token-level latency and divergence numbers.
julien: for quantization, make sure to test both per-channel and per-tensor schemes; sometimes vocab frequent tokens are impacted. run this script: 
```
python tools/quantize.py --model s3://partner-bucket/models/amber-3b/weights.pt --modes 8bit,4bit --calib-samples 1024 --out /tmp/qtests
```
ci-bot: CI job queued: qtest-amber-3b-1799000000. Will post results here when complete.
mike: ephemeral checklist for ingest PR: - add manifest + checksums to registry entry - attach gpg verifier output - add license & vendor contact - add S3 origin + KMS key id - set read_only retention policy - set provenance flag = true
sarah: I'm adding unit tests for tokenizer: decode(encode(sample_text)) == sample_text_normalized (within unicode normalization NFKC).
opsec: confirm KMS key used: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01. If not using customer-managed KMS, we need to escalate for Private customers.
mohit: QA acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) checksums & signature verified 2) smoke gen passes 80% basic coherence 3) no tokenization drift > 0.5% mismatch on canonical prompts 4) quantization top-1 token divergence < 2% (8-bit) and < 5% (4-bit) vs float baseline 5) embedding cosine drop < 0.03 vs baseline on eval set.
anna: I'll create the registry entry after CI posts qtest results. tagging: model_id=amber-3b, version=2026-03-16, provenance=partner/amber, priority=standard.
mike: for storage retention, follow artifactory retention policy: 90 days hot, 365 days cold in cold-bucket. Add lifecycle rule.
julien: small gotcha: tokenizer merges.txt had an extra BOM char, broke our loader. I patched a preprocessor to strip BOM; will add to ingest PR.
ci-bot: qtest completed: 8bit and 4bit quant passes. artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/qtests/amber-3b/1799000000/results.json
mohit: results.json looks good at glance. mike can you review perf numbers and confirm no latency regressions?
mike: latency ok. 8bit avg token latency +12% but still within SLO. 4bit shows +45% on our runtime due to dequant overhead on current kernel; flagging for runtime team separately.
opsec: final checklist before registry commit: confirm no PII in manifests, confirm license, confirm KMS encryption, set ACLs to internal-only.
sarah: tests all green, tokenizer roundtrip within 0.2% drift. embedding drop = 0.018.
anna: merging ingest PR now, creating registry entry and marking as onboarded draft. tagging owners: @mohit @sarah for post-onboard eval watchlist.
mohit: thanks everyone. good template for next partner ingest. :tada:
